By Gessel-Reutenauer (1993), n betaCyc_n(I) - beta_n(I) is the sum over divisors d > 1 of mu(d) times the value of the ribbon character of I at cycle type d^(n/d); a ribbon with nonempty proper descent set has no trivial or sign constituent, every other irreducible has dimension at least n - 1, and the Fomin-Lulov bound (1997; in the form of Swanson, Algebraic Combinatorics 1 (2018), Lemma 4.1 and Corollary 4.13) gives |chi(d^(n/d))|/f = O(n^(-1/4)) uniformly, so the ratio differs from 1 by O(tau(n) n^(-1/4)). Found by audit lane Q12 (GPT-6.2 Sol); root checked the argument itself. The Opus reviews had not considered character bounds.
